article.title: Jovan Hadži-Vasiljević
article.description: Serbian historian, ethnographer, journalist and writer
article.extract: Jovan Hadži-Vasiljević was a Serbian historian, ethnographer, journalist and writer.

turns.guesser:
So far I understand: a Serbian man, deceased. He seems to have been a historian/politician (📜🏛️), journalist (📰), writer (✍️), and maybe studied people/peasants/geography (ethnographer or agrarian politician?). He lived from the old Kingdom era, through WWI, into WWII (bombing).

Questions:
1. Was he a politician (🏛️ = parliament/government)? Or 📜🏛️ = historian?
2. Did he die during WWII (in a bombing / plane)?
3. Is 👥🧑‍🌾 about peasants — an agrarian/peasant party, or ethnography of village people?

GUESS: Vladimir Ćorović

Got it — not a politician, a historian and ethnographer who died after WWII. The name clue: baptism → John (Jovan); pilgrim walking to Jerusalem → "Hadži"; crown + herb = Basil → Vasiljević.

GUESS: Jovan Hadži-Vasiljević
